info.title: PoYo AI - Happy Horse API
info.description: The Happy Horse API generates 3–15 second 720p or 1080p video from text, one first frame, or up to nine reference images, or edits a source video while keeping or replacing its audio.

post.description: Generate or edit video with Alibaba Happy Horse

input.prompt: A small robot barista prepares coffee in a sunlit Tokyo cafe, cinematic camera movement, warm ambient sound.
Bring the scene in the image to life with gentle camera movement.
A dance battle between character1 and character2, cinematic lighting, smooth camera movement.
Recolor the sky to a deep purple sunset.

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for result notifications

prompt.description: Text prompt. Required for text-to-video, reference-to-video, and video-edit. Optional for image-to-video. Maximum length is 5,000 non-Chinese characters or 2,500 Chinese characters.
prompt.example: A small robot barista prepares coffee in a sunlit Tokyo cafe, cinematic camera movement, warm ambient sound.

image_urls.description: Single-item first-frame image URL array for image-to-video. Do not combine with reference_image_urls or video_url.

reference_image_urls.description: Reference images. For reference-to-video, provide 1-9 images and refer to them as character1, character2, and so on in the prompt. For video-edit, provide up to 5 optional images and refer to them as @Image1, @Image2, and so on.

video_url.description: Source video URL for video-edit. Supported source duration is 3-60 seconds. Output follows the source video and truncates longer input to the first 15 seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio for text-to-video and reference-to-video

duration.description: Output duration in seconds for text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video. Ignored for video-edit because the output follows the source video and is capped at 15 seconds.

audio_setting.description: Video-edit audio handling. `auto` lets the model decide whether to regenerate audio; `origin` preserves original audio.

seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible generation

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable content moderation for input and output

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`
